Oliver Goldsmith

Est. 1926, Oliver Goldsmith has been a pioneer of iconic eyewear for nearly a century. Worn by Hollywood stars and rock legends alike, our frames represent timeless British style, innovation, and craftsmanship. Designed in London. Handcrafted with purpose.
